name: audio-player
title: Audio Player
description: A compact custom audio transport with play/pause, skip, seek, a tappable speed control, and keyboard shortcuts — a single line on a wide player, two lines with an optional transcript control on a narrow, mobile-width player.

meta.whenToUse: A single audio asset that needs a compact, branded transport with rewind/forward, a tappable speed control, keyboard shortcuts, and a two-line mobile layout with an optional transcript control.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playlists, queue management, waveform editing, transcript navigation, or audio recording.
